claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: The witness only reports an IBC-style caged water storage tank with valves/label stickers; no readable grade/approval plate or markings confirming hazardous/chemical use.

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/volume and exact model/serial (affects market value and buyer suitability).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the capacity/volume rating and the model/serial plate/label (close-up, readable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic IBC-style caged tank with unknown capacity.

risks.risk: Food-grade vs chemical-grade status is unknown (major price driver in Rivers).
risks.proof: A clear photo of any grade/approval markings (e.g., food-grade/UN/DOT/chemical compatibility) on the tank or label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-confirmed grade (treated as general industrial use only).

risks.risk: Condition risk: possible dents, cracks, leaks, or seal/valve wear not visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Video/close-ups showing the entire tank surface and cage joints, plus a test of the valve/tap (open/close) and underside/base integrity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/with risk of leaks or valve wear.

risks.risk: Faint markings/serial are not readable; brand/model unknown (affects replacement parts and buyer confidence).
risks.proof: A straight-on close-up of the label/markings so the brand/model/serial can be read.

risks.risk: Accessories/parts may be missing (hoses, caps, fittings, correct tap components).
risks.proof: A photo list showing all included parts laid out, and confirmation that the valve/tap assembly is complete and functional.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as minimal/only what is visible (tank + shown valve), with missing accessories assumed possible.

risks.risk: Transport/frame integrity risk: cage bars or base frame could be bent or damaged (not fully verifiable from angles).
risks.proof: Photos of the full cage from all sides and the base/frame alignment, including any damaged bars or weld points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used condition with potential frame issues.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the capacity/volume rating and any model/serial plate (readable).
Clear close-up photo of grade/approval markings (food-grade vs chemical-grade; any UN/DOT/compatibility labels).
Video showing the valve/tap operating (open/close) and checking for seepage/leaks.
Full-surface photos (top, sides, bottom/underside) to confirm no cracks/dents/rust-through.
Photos of all included accessories/fittings (hose, caps, couplers) laid out and counted.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as an IBC-style caged storage tank, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. The seller’s hazardous/industrial claim is not verifiable from the provided report, so pricing should assume unknown grade and potential need for inspection.
